B2L03-G01-P75.title: Practice: directional verb + 來 / 去

items.prompt: She is in the room and you are outside the door. What does she want to do?

promptZh.traditional: 她在房間裡，你在門外。她要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 她在房间里，你在门外。她要做什么？

repairs.note: 出去 moves away from the speaker; she is coming out toward you.
進來 means coming in; she is going out of the room.
過去 means going over there; she is coming out here.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 出來: she comes out toward you.

result.traditional: 這個人要出來。
result.simplified: 这个人要出来。
result.pinyin: Zhège rén yào chūlái.
result.english: This person wants to come out.

items.prompt: Mom is outside the door and your brother is in front of her. What does she say?

promptZh.traditional: 媽媽在門外，弟弟在媽媽前面。媽媽說什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 妈妈在门外，弟弟在妈妈前面。妈妈说什么？

repairs.note: 過去 is away from Mom; she wants him to come to her.
進來 means coming into a room; they are both outside.
出去 means going out; he is already outside with her.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 過來: she calls him to come to her.

result.traditional: 媽媽說：「過來。」
result.simplified: 妈妈说：「过来。」
result.pinyin: Māma shuō: Guòlái.
result.english: Mom says to come over.

items.prompt: Your friend is waiting outside. What do you need to do?

promptZh.traditional: 朋友在外面等你。你要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 朋友在外面等你。你要做什么？

segments.traditional: 我朋友在外面等我，我現在要
segments.simplified: 我朋友在外面等我，我现在要

repairs.note: 出來 is toward the speaker; you are inside and going out to your friend.
上去 means going up, not going out.
進去 means going in; your friend is outside.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 出去: you go out to your friend.

result.traditional: 我朋友在外面等我，我現在要出去。
result.simplified: 我朋友在外面等我，我现在要出去。
result.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu zài wàimiàn děng wǒ, wǒ xiànzài yào chūqù.
result.english: My friend is waiting outside; I need to go out now.

items.prompt: Your brother is watching TV upstairs. What does Mom want him to do?

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟在樓上看電視。媽媽要他做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟在楼上看电视。妈妈要他做什么？

segments.traditional: 快吃飯了，弟弟還在樓上看電視，媽媽要他
segments.simplified: 快吃饭了，弟弟还在楼上看电视，妈妈要他

repairs.note: 下去 is away from Mom; she wants him down here.
上來 means coming up; he is already upstairs.
上去 means going up; he needs to come down.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 下來: he is upstairs and comes down to eat.

result.traditional: 快吃飯了，弟弟還在樓上看電視，媽媽要他下來吃飯。
result.simplified: 快吃饭了，弟弟还在楼上看电视，妈妈要他下来吃饭。
result.pinyin: Kuài chīfàn le, dìdi hái zài lóushàng kàn diànshì, māma yào tā xiàlái chīfàn.
result.english: Dinner is almost ready; your brother is still watching TV upstairs, so Mom wants him to come down to eat.

items.prompt: Your friend is outside the door. You want him to come into the room.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友在門外。你要他進房間。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友在门外。你要他进房间。

sentence.traditional: 請他進來。
sentence.simplified: 请他进来。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng tā jìnlái.
sentence.english: Ask him to come in.

sentence.traditional: 請進來。
sentence.simplified: 请进来。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng jìnlái.
sentence.english: Please come in.

repairs.note: 進去 is going in away from you; you are inside and want him to come to you.
出去 means going out; he is outside and you want him in.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 請 + him + 進來.

items.prompt: Your brother is playing outside. Mom calls him back home to eat.

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟在外面玩。媽媽叫他回家吃飯。
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟在外面玩。妈妈叫他回家吃饭。

sentence.traditional: 媽媽叫他回來吃飯。
sentence.simplified: 妈妈叫他回来吃饭。
sentence.pinyin: Māma jiào tā huílái chīfàn.
sentence.english: Mom calls him back to eat.

repairs.note: 回去 means going back away from home; Mom wants him back here.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 媽媽 + 叫他 + 回來 + 吃飯.

items.prompt: You are upstairs and your friend is downstairs.

promptZh.traditional: 你在樓上，朋友在樓下。
promptZh.simplified: 你在楼上，朋友在楼下。

repairs.note: 下來 means coming down; your friend is downstairs and must come up.
進去 means going in, not coming up to you.

items.hint: You are upstairs; ask your friend to come up to you.

result.traditional: 我在樓上，請你上來。
result.simplified: 我在楼上，请你上来。
result.pinyin: Wǒ zài lóushàng, qǐng nǐ shànglái.
result.english: I am upstairs; please come up.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 上去 leaves 請你, which does not say where to come.

items.prompt: Your brother is on the second floor and wants to go to the first floor. How does he get there?

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟在二樓，要到一樓。他怎麼到一樓？
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟在二楼，要到一楼。他怎么到一楼？

repairs.note: The sentence says he runs fast, not walks.
跑上去 goes up; he starts on the second floor and goes down.
跑出去 means running out, not down the stairs.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 跑下來: he runs down from the second floor.

result.traditional: 孩子從二樓跑下來。
result.simplified: 孩子从二楼跑下来。
result.pinyin: Háizi cóng èr lóu pǎo xiàlái.
result.english: The child runs down from the second floor.

items.prompt: The man is inside the convenience store. You are outside waiting for him. How does he get outside?

promptZh.traditional: 先生在便利商店裡面。你在外面等他。他怎麼到外面？
promptZh.simplified: 先生在便利商店里面。你在外面等他。他怎么到外面？

repairs.note: 走進去 goes in; he is inside and comes out to you.
走回來 means coming back; he is simply coming out of the store.
走過去 goes over there; he comes out toward you.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 走出來: he walks out toward you.

result.traditional: 那位先生從便利商店走出來。
result.simplified: 那位先生从便利商店走出来。
result.pinyin: Nà wèi xiānshēng cóng biànlì shāngdiàn zǒu chūlái.
result.english: That man walks out of the convenience store.

items.prompt: What should you do when you talk to your boss?

promptZh.traditional: 跟老闆說話的時候，你要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 跟老板说话的时候，你要做什么？

segments.traditional: 跟老闆說話的時候，請你
segments.simplified: 跟老板说话的时候，请你

repairs.note: 坐下來 means sit down, but the sentence says not to sit.
站出去 means stand outside, not stand up.
坐起來 means sit up in bed; you need to stand.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 站起來: stand up.

result.traditional: 跟老闆說話的時候，請你站起來，不要坐著。
result.simplified: 跟老板说话的时候，请你站起来，不要坐着。
result.pinyin: Gēn lǎobǎn shuōhuà de shíhou, qǐng nǐ zhàn qǐlái, búyào zuò zhe.
result.english: When you talk to your boss, please stand up; do not stay seated.

items.prompt: The garbage stinks. What do you ask someone to do?

promptZh.traditional: 垃圾很臭。請你做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 垃圾很臭。请你做什么？

repairs.note: 拿進來 brings it in; smelly garbage goes out.
放下去 means put it down; the garbage must go out.
拿回來 brings it back; you want it out.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 拿出去: take the garbage out.

result.traditional: 這些垃圾很臭，請你拿出去。
result.simplified: 这些垃圾很臭，请你拿出去。
result.pinyin: Zhèxiē lèsè hěn chòu, qǐng nǐ ná chūqù.
result.english: This garbage stinks; please take it out.

items.prompt: It is raining. He runs in from outside.

promptZh.traditional: 外面下雨了。他從外面跑進房子裡。
promptZh.simplified: 外面下雨了。他从外面跑进房子里。

sentence.traditional: 他從外面跑進來。
sentence.simplified: 他从外面跑进来。
sentence.pinyin: Tā cóng wàimiàn pǎo jìnlái.
sentence.english: He runs in from outside.

repairs.note: 跑出去 means running out; the rain makes him run in.
Use 跑進來: the verb 跑 comes before 進來.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 他 + 從 + 外面 + 跑進來.

items.prompt: The sofa is heavy. We need to carry it upstairs.

promptZh.traditional: 沙發很重。我們要搬到樓上。
promptZh.simplified: 沙发很重。我们要搬到楼上。

sentence.traditional: 沙發很重，我們一起搬上去。
sentence.simplified: 沙发很重，我们一起搬上去。
sentence.pinyin: Shāfā hěn zhòng, wǒmen yìqǐ bān shàngqù.
sentence.english: The sofa is heavy; let us carry it up together.

sentence.traditional: 沙發很重，我們搬上去。
sentence.simplified: 沙发很重，我们搬上去。
sentence.pinyin: Shāfā hěn zhòng, wǒmen bān shàngqù.
sentence.english: The sofa is heavy; we'll carry it up.

repairs.note: 搬下來 means carry it down; you are taking it up.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 沙發很重 + 我們 + 搬上去; 一起 is optional.

items.prompt: When the teacher comes into the classroom, everyone is not sitting.

promptZh.traditional: 老師進教室的時候，大家都不坐著。
promptZh.simplified: 老师进教室的时候，大家都不坐着。

repairs.note: 坐下來 means sit down; everyone is not sitting, so they stand.
站出去 means stand outside; they are in the classroom.

items.hint: When the teacher comes in, everyone stands up.

result.traditional: 老師進教室的時候，我們都站起來。
result.simplified: 老师进教室的时候，我们都站起来。
result.pinyin: Lǎoshī jìn jiàoshì de shíhou, wǒmen dōu zhàn qǐlái.
result.english: When the teacher comes into the classroom, we all stand up.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 站上來 leaves 我們都, which does not say what everyone did.

B2L03-G03-P78.title: Practice: motion verb + directional verb + place

items.prompt: You are at the fruit shop and want to take the fruit home. What do you say?

promptZh.traditional: 你在水果店，想帶水果回家。你要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 你在水果店，想带水果回家。你要做什么？

repairs.note: 帶回來 brings them toward the shop; you are taking them home, away from here.
拿出來 means take them out; you are taking them home.
帶過去 means take them over there; you are taking them back home.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 帶回去: take the fruit back home.

result.traditional: 這些水果，我要帶回去。
result.simplified: 这些水果，我要带回去。
result.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ, wǒ yào dài huíqù.
result.english: These fruits—I want to take them back.

items.prompt: You are upstairs and the sofa is downstairs. What do you want to do?

promptZh.traditional: 你在樓上，沙發在樓下。你要做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 你在楼上，沙发在楼下。你要做什么？

repairs.note: 搬下去 means carry it down; you are upstairs and want it here.
搬過來 means carry it over; it is downstairs and must come up.
搬上去 means carry it up away from you; you are already upstairs.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 搬上來: move the sofa up to you.

result.traditional: 樓下的那張沙發，我要搬上來。
result.simplified: 楼下的那张沙发，我要搬上来。
result.pinyin: Lóuxià de nà zhāng shāfā, wǒ yào bān shànglái.
result.english: That sofa downstairs—I want to move it up here.

items.prompt: Your wallet is in the living room. What do you ask your friend to do?

promptZh.traditional: 錢包在客廳。請朋友幫你做什麼？
promptZh.simplified: 钱包在客厅。请朋友帮你做什么？

segments.traditional: 我的錢包放在客廳，請你幫我
segments.simplified: 我的钱包放在客厅，请你帮我

repairs.note: 拿進去 takes it further in; the wallet is inside and you want it out.
拿回來 means bring it back; it is in the living room, not away.
拿過去 takes it over there; you want it here.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 拿出來: take the wallet out to me.

result.traditional: 我的錢包放在客廳，請你幫我拿出來。
result.simplified: 我的钱包放在客厅，请你帮我拿出来。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo fàng zài kètīng, qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ ná chūlái.
result.english: My wallet is in the living room; please get it out for me.

items.prompt: These books are yours. You want to take the books back to Japan. Say it with 去.

promptZh.traditional: 這些書是你的。你要帶書回日本。用「去」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这些书是你的。你要带书回日本。用「去」说。

sentence.traditional: 這些書，我要帶回日本去。
sentence.simplified: 这些书，我要带回日本去。
sentence.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū, wǒ yào dài huí Rìběn qù.
sentence.english: These books—I want to take them back to Japan.

repairs.note: 帶去 has no place; say 帶回 + 日本 + 去.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 帶回 + 日本 + 去: the place goes before 去.

items.prompt: This glass of water; please take it to the kitchen. Say it with 去.

promptZh.traditional: 這杯水，請你拿到廚房。用「去」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这杯水，请你拿到厨房。用「去」说。

sentence.traditional: 這杯水，請你拿到廚房去。
sentence.simplified: 这杯水，请你拿到厨房去。
sentence.pinyin: Zhè bēi shuǐ, qǐng nǐ ná dào chúfáng qù.
sentence.english: This glass of water—please take it to the kitchen.

repairs.note: 拿來 cannot take a place after it; use 拿到 + place + 去.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 拿到 + 廚房 + 去.

items.prompt: The puppy is outside and you are in the room. The puppy runs into your room. Say it with 來.

promptZh.traditional: 小狗在外面，你在房間裡。小狗跑進你的房間。用「來」說。
promptZh.simplified: 小狗在外面，你在房间里。小狗跑进你的房间。用「来」说。

sentence.traditional: 小狗從外面跑進房間裡來。
sentence.simplified: 小狗从外面跑进房间里来。
sentence.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu cóng wàimiàn pǎo jìn fángjiān lǐ lái.
sentence.english: The puppy runs in from outside into the room.

repairs.note: 去 is away from you; the puppy comes into your room, so use 來.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 小狗 + 從外面 + 跑進 + 房間裡 + 來.

items.prompt: Put the sentence in order.

promptZh.traditional: 把句子排好。
promptZh.simplified: 把句子排好。

sentence.traditional: 我昨天沒把書帶回家去。
sentence.simplified: 我昨天没把书带回家去。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān méi bǎ shū dài huí jiā qù.
sentence.english: I did not take the book home yesterday.

repairs.note: 已經 would say you did take it home; the sentence says you did not.
Put 沒 before 把: the negation comes first.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 我昨天 first, then 沒 + 把 + 書 + 帶回家去.

items.prompt: Put the sentence in order.

promptZh.traditional: 把句子排好。
promptZh.simplified: 把句子排好。

sentence.traditional: 孩子把垃圾丟進袋子裡去。
sentence.simplified: 孩子把垃圾丢进袋子里去。
sentence.pinyin: Háizi bǎ lèsè diū jìn dàizi lǐ qù.
sentence.english: The child throws the garbage into the bag.

repairs.note: 進來 means come in; the sentence says throw the garbage into the bag.
Put 把 before 垃圾: 把 marks the thing being moved.

items.fallbackRepair: Put 孩子 + 把 + 垃圾 + 丟進 + 袋子裡去.
items.sub: 孩子丟垃圾。垃圾在袋子裡。

items.prompt: Put the sentence in order.

promptZh.traditional: 把句子排好。
promptZh.simplified: 把句子排好。

sentence.traditional: 請你把杯子拿起來，我要擦桌子。
sentence.simplified: 请你把杯子拿起来，我要擦桌子。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ bēizi ná qǐlái, wǒ yào cā zhuōzi.
sentence.english: Please pick up the cup; I want to wipe the table.

sentence.traditional: 我要擦桌子，請你把杯子拿起來。
sentence.simplified: 我要擦桌子，请你把杯子拿起来。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yào cā zhuōzi, qǐng nǐ bǎ bēizi ná qǐlái.
sentence.english: I want to wipe the table; please pick up the cup.

repairs.note: 放下來 means put it down; you need the cup picked up so you can wipe the table.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 請你 + 把杯子 + 拿起來, then 我要 + 擦桌子.
items.sub: 杯子在桌子上。你要擦桌子。

items.prompt: The desk is at the door and you want it beside you.

promptZh.traditional: 書桌在門口，你要書桌在你旁邊。
promptZh.simplified: 书桌在门口，你要书桌在你旁边。

repairs.note: 搬上去 means carry it up, not over to you.
搬出去 means carry it out; you want it here.

items.hint: The desk should come over to you; the verb needs a direction after it.

result.traditional: 請你把書桌搬過來。
result.simplified: 请你把书桌搬过来。
result.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ shūzhuō bān guòlái.
result.english: Please move the desk over here.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 搬 leaves 請你把書桌, which has no verb.

items.prompt: The fruit was downstairs; now it is upstairs. Say it with 把.

promptZh.traditional: 水果在樓下，現在在樓上了。用「把」說。
promptZh.simplified: 水果在楼下，现在在楼上了。用「把」说。

sentence.traditional: 姐姐把水果拿上樓去了。
sentence.simplified: 姐姐把水果拿上楼去了。
sentence.pinyin: Jiějie bǎ shuǐguǒ ná shànglóu qù le.
sentence.english: My sister took the fruit upstairs.

repairs.note: 拿下來 means bring it down; she takes it up.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 姐姐 + 把 + 水果 + 拿上樓 + 去了.

items.prompt: The foreign student wants to get to know Taiwanese friends. Say 認識 twice.

promptZh.traditional: 外國學生想認識台灣朋友。用「認識」說兩次。
promptZh.simplified: 外国学生想认识台湾朋友。用「认识」说两次。

segments.traditional: 外國學生希望有機會可以
segments.simplified: 外国学生希望有机会可以

repairs.note: The book form is XYXY, not 一下.
Use the doubled form 認識認識.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 認識認識: double the two-syllable verb.

result.traditional: 外國學生希望有機會可以認識認識台灣朋友。
result.simplified: 外国学生希望有机会可以认识认识台湾朋友。
result.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng xīwàng yǒu jīhuì kěyǐ rènshì rènshì Táiwān péngyǒu.
result.english: The foreign student hopes to have a chance to get to know Taiwanese friends.

items.prompt: You finished the housework and feel tired. Say 休息 twice.

promptZh.traditional: 你做完家事，覺得很累。用「休息」說兩次。
promptZh.simplified: 你做完家事，觉得很累。用「休息」说两次。

segments.traditional: 我一個人把家事都做完了，覺得有點兒累，要
segments.simplified: 我一个人把家事都做完了，觉得有点儿累，要

repairs.note: The book form is XYXY, not 一下.
You are tired, so you rest, not practice.
There is nothing to celebrate; you are tired.

items.fallbackRepair: Use 休息休息: double the verb for a short rest.

result.traditional: 我一個人把家事都做完了，覺得有點兒累，要休息休息。
result.simplified: 我一个人把家事都做完了，觉得有点儿累，要休息休息。
result.pinyin: Wǒ yí ge rén bǎ jiāshì dōu zuò wán le, juéde yǒu diǎnr lèi, yào xiūxí xiūxí.
result.english: I finished all the housework alone and feel a little tired, so I want to rest a bit.

items.prompt: Tomorrow is Mom's birthday. Say 慶祝 twice.

promptZh.traditional: 明天是媽媽的生日。用「慶祝」說兩次。
promptZh.simplified: 明天是妈妈的生日。用「庆祝」说两次。

segments.traditional: 明天是媽媽的生日，我們要買蛋糕給她
segments.simplified: 明天是妈妈的生日，我们要买蛋糕给她

repairs.note: The book form is XYXY, not 一下.
A birthday is celebrated; 歡迎 means welcome.

items.prompt: Your brother kicked the soccer ball; the ball went far away.

promptZh.traditional: 弟弟踢足球，球跑到很遠的地方。
promptZh.simplified: 弟弟踢足球，球跑到很远的地方。

repairs.note: 了 marks a finished action; the comment 很遠 needs 得.
踢 alone does not connect to the comment 很遠; use 踢得.

items.hint: The comment 很遠 needs the degree pattern, not a finished-action marker.

result.traditional: 弟弟把足球踢得很遠。
result.simplified: 弟弟把足球踢得很远。
result.pinyin: Dìdi bǎ zúqiú tī de hěn yuǎn.
result.english: My younger brother kicked the soccer ball very far.

items.takeOutNote: Taking out 踢了 leaves 弟弟把足球很遠, which has no verb.

items.prompt: This matter is already strange. Tell him not to make it stranger. Say it with 把 and 得.

promptZh.traditional: 這件事已經很奇怪。你叫他不要再弄。用「把」和「得」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这件事已经很奇怪。你叫他不要再弄。用「把」和「得」说。

sentence.traditional: 請你不要把這件事弄得更奇怪。
sentence.simplified: 请你不要把这件事弄得更奇怪。
sentence.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ búyào bǎ zhè jiàn shì nòng de gèng qíguài.
sentence.english: Please do not make this matter even stranger.

repairs.note: 更 is already in 弄得更; do not repeat it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 請你 + 不要 + 把這件事 + 弄得更 + 奇怪.
